title: Absorbing one level of a depth-two circuit
statement: Let $D$ be layer-2 data over $n$ variables: a family of DNF gates $g_0,\dots,g_{m-1}$ together with a common positive width bound. Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit whose $m$ inputs are indexed by these gates and whose depth is at least $2$, and let $l\ge 1$. Suppose that for each index $i$ the gate $g_i$ admits a DNF formula of width at most $l$ that computes the same Boolean function as $g_i$ and in which, within every term, distinct literals use distinct variables and no literal is repeated, as well as a CNF formula of width at most $l$ computing that same Boolean function. Then there exist layer-2 data $D'$ over $n$ variables of width at most $l$, with gate family $h_0,\dots,h_{k-1}$, and a Boolean circuit $C'$ whose $k$ inputs are indexed by these gates and whose depth is at most $\mathrm{depth}(C)-1$, such that for every assignment $x\colon\mathrm{Fin}\,n\to\{\mathrm{true},\mathrm{false}\}$ the value of $C$ on the input vector $\bigl(g_i(x)\bigr)_i$ equals the value of $C'$ on the input vector $\bigl(h_j(x)\bigr)_j$.
hypotheses_covered: layer-2 data $D$ over $n$ variables (a DNF gate family with a positive common width bound)
top circuit $C$ on the gates as inputs
each gate has a width-$\le l$ DNF computing the same function, with per-term variable-injective, duplicate-free literals
each gate has a width-$\le l$ CNF computing the same function
replaced:
The $\mathrm{Layer2Data}$ wrapper of the general depth reduction: for $c_{\mathrm{top}}$ of
depth at least $2$ (with $0 < l$) over gates having width-$l$ DNF and CNF representations,
there are a new $\mathrm{Layer2Data}'$ of width at most $l$ and a circuit $c_{\mathrm{top}}'$
of depth at most $\mathrm{depth}\,c_{\mathrm{top}} - 1$ computing the same function.
